nav: Your first star system by hand

Cannon.title: Cannon
Cannon.description: A small calibre machine gun that rapidly fires kinetic projectiles. Very effective against armour and less effective against shields.

Collector Drone Controller.title: Collector Drone Controller
Collector Drone Controller.description: Drone control module for faster cargo collection from outer space. Uses drones from cargo rack.

Cargo Rack.title: Cargo Rack
Cargo Rack.description: Designed for placing cargo on spacecrafts.

Cargo Scanner.title: Cargo Scanner
Cargo Scanner.description: Scans the ship for cargo. It turns on automatically when there is a target for the ship.

Chaff Launcher.title: Chaff Launcher
Chaff Launcher.description: Deploys a payload of signal-disrupting chaff that instantly breaks tracking locks from weapons of enemy ships.

Warp Drive.title: Warp Drive
Warp Drive.description: This engine type is used for travelling between different star systems.

Warp Drive Booster.title: Warp Drive Booster
Warp Drive Booster.description: This module type is used to boost the output of Warp Drive, increasing jump distance.

Defence Turret.title: Defence Turret
Defence Turret.description: Automatic missile defense system. Shoots down most of the missiles approaching your ship.

Experimental Booster.title: Experimental Booster
Experimental Booster.description: A module that improves some ship parameters.

Fighter Hangar.title: Fighter Hangar
Fighter Hangar.description: The Fighter Hangar is an internal module that can carry Ship-Launched Fighters.

Fragment Cannon.title: Fragment Cannon
Fragment Cannon.description: A weapon module that fires burst containing 12 projectiles, similar to a shotgun. Very effective against armour and less effective against shields.

Fuel Scoop.title: Fuel Scoop
Fuel Scoop.description: Allows you to refuel your fuel tank from most of the stars. You have to fly to the star close enough to start refueling.

Fuel Tank.title: Fuel Tank
Fuel Tank.description: Fuel is needed for warp jumps between different planet systems. The bigger your fuel tank is, the further you can fly without refueling.

Gauss Gun.title: Gauss Gun
Gauss Gun.description: A powerful electromagnetic projectile weapon that inflicts both thermal and kinetic damage.

Heatsink Launcher.title: Heatsink Launcher
Heatsink Launcher.description: Allows to reset ship heat in a moment.

Hull.title: Hull
Hull.description: The type of spacecraft hull affects the resistance to various types of damage.

Hull Reinforcement.title: Hull Reinforcement
Hull Reinforcement.description: Additional parts of ship hull which allow to take more damage before the spacecraft is totally destroyed.

Beam Laser.title: Beam Laser
Beam Laser.description: An energy weapon that continuously emits a laser beam. The Beam Laser inflicts thermal damage. Very effective against shields and less effective against armour.

Life Support.title: Life Support
Life Support.description: Turns on if the spacecraft is critically damaged, and allows you to control the spacecraft for some time even if it is depressurized.

Mines.title: Mines
Mines.description: Mines are charges that explode a short time after the enemy approaches. Mine activation takes 2 seconds after dropping. Mines have stabilizing engines that allow them to be used even while moving.

Mining Laser.title: Mining Laser
Mining Laser.description: Allows to extract minerals and metals from asteroids. Activated automatically when you tap and hold the asteroid down.

Missiles.title: Missiles
Missiles.description: A weapon module that launches explosive-tipped missiles.

Energy wakes scanner.title: Energy wakes scanner
Energy wakes scanner.description: Allows you to receive data on the use of warp drives and energy shields.

Criminals Scanner.title: Criminals Scanner
Criminals Scanner.description: Scans the ship for the presence on the wanted list. Increases the elimination reward. It turns on automatically when there is a target for the ship.

Planet Scanner.title: Planet Scanner
Planet Scanner.description: Detects unknown planets. Responsible for scanning the planet surface and thus makes research data many times more valuable.

Plasma Cannon.title: Plasma Cannon
Plasma Cannon.description: A weapon module that fires slugs of superheated plasma. Its projectiles travel relatively slowly, and they require a brief period to recharge after each shot. Same effectiveness against shields and armor.

Power Distributor.title: Power Distributor
Power Distributor.description: Regulates the distribution of power from the Power Plant between the ship's main subsystems

Power Plant.title: Power Plant
Power Plant.description: Produces energy which is then consumed by all the spacecraft modules.

Pulse Laser.title: Pulse Laser
Pulse Laser.description: An energy weapon that emits intermittent laser blast. The Pulse Laser inflicts thermal damage. Very effective against shields and less effective against armour.

Railgun.title: Railgun
Railgun.description: Electromagnetic projectile weapon that inflicts both thermal and kinetic damage. Partially passes through ship shields.

Repair Module.title: Repair Module
Repair Module.description: Allows to repair other modules in case there are enough spare parts.

Seismic charges.title: Seismic charges
Seismic charges.description: The seismic charge launcher is designed to destroy the integrity of asteroids, allowing access to more valuable resources.

Sensors.title: Sensors
Sensors.description: Used for detecting the nearest spacecrafts and objects.

Shields Cell Bank.title: Shields Cell Bank
Shields Cell Bank.description: An energy capacitor for quick recovery of shields. Its usage increases heat load significantly.

Shields.title: Shields
Shields.description: Energy shield which can take a certain amount of damage before the hull is damaged.

Shields Booster.title: Shields Booster
Shields Booster.description: Increase the strength of a ship's shields which allows to take more damage.

Thrusters.title: Thrusters
Thrusters.description: Thrusters are responsible for acceleration and angular rate of spacecraft.

Energy Lance.title: Energy Lance
Energy Lance.description: An energy weapon that continuously emits a laser beam. The Lance inflicts thermal damage. The longer the beam continues, the more damage is dealt.

Torpedoes.title: Torpedoes
Torpedoes.description: A weapon module that launches explosive-tipped missiles. Low speed of the missile is compensated by a long targeting range.

Planetary Vehicle.title: Planetary Vehicle
Planetary Vehicle.description: Planetary Vehicle module required for landing on planets. Planetary Vehicle allows you to collect resources from the surface of planets.

Zentarks cannon.title: Zentarks cannon
Zentarks cannon.description: An energy weapon that emits intermittent laser blast. The Pulse Laser inflicts thermal damage.

Shadow jump module.title: Shadow jump module
Shadow jump module.description: A module that replaces the afterburner with Zentarks technology for local teleportation.

Shield Cell Bank.title: Shields Cell Bank
Shield Cell Bank.description: An energy capacitor for quick recovery of shields. Its usage increases heat load significantly.
